positive_prompts: Audit my Python library for security vulnerabilities before we release.
Set up Bandit, pip-audit and detect-secrets scanning in CI for this package.
Check this code for SQL injection, command injection and unsafe pickle loading.

negative_prompts.prompt: Render user-submitted Markdown as HTML without allowing script injection in my web page.
I accidentally committed a .env file; remove it from the repo and fix the ignore rules.
Do a general health review of my library covering structure, docs and tests.

rubric: Runs skills/python/security-audit/scripts/security_scan.py (or the individual scanners) against the target project path
Reports which scanners ran and which did not; a scanner that was unavailable is reported as not run, never as a clean result
Findings are listed with severity and file location, with blocking findings (high severity, vulnerable dependencies, detected secrets) called out separately
Each reported injection or deserialization issue includes a concrete remediation
When asked to wire CI, a workflow step invokes the scan and fails the job on blocking findings
